code:
OLD GATE:
IF  request comes from inside the corporate network
THEN allow access

NEW GATE:
IF  identity is verified (strong auth, MFA)
THEN allow access
(network location no longer matters)
caption: The checkpoint moved from the network edge to the sign-in itself.

steps.label: Resources Left the Network
steps.sub: Cloud apps and data are reachable from the open internet

steps.label: No Edge to Defend
steps.sub: There's no single network boundary left to gate access

steps.label: Identity Is What's Left
steps.sub: Who you are, proven strongly, is the only consistent control point

eyebrow: IAM and MFA: the real front line

steps.label: Strong Authentication
steps.sub: MFA makes a stolen password alone useless

steps.label: Least-Privilege Roles
steps.sub: IAM grants only the access a given identity actually needs

steps.label: Every Access Request
steps.sub: Identity is checked on each request, not just once at the door

subtitle: Verifying trust throughout a session, not just at login.
